verdict.rationale: Scoped or least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for an accounting SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only says a full accounting API and an MCP layer are coming 'soon', and the role-tailored permissions it describes are for human accountant seats, not agent API credentials. The probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
